crossRefs.note: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me; and the Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to…
The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for…
For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the…
But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
translations.bsb: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:
translations.asv: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Jehovah come.
